csharpDecision: SemanticCompiler common owned literal collector traverses Box, materializes readonly read identity, preserves fixed-storage copy, and rejects borrowed storage at the Box operand. EmitBoxExpression transfers operand storage only after materialization/store through RemoveOwnedLiteralSources.
nativeDecision: Extend existing aggregate move event and overlap collectors with the Box opcode. Recognize Box as a storage destination in the existing borrowed-owned escape analysis, keep the operand span and shared diagnostic text, and preserve fixed-storage copy. Existing move events drive cleanup; no separate Box ownership engine.
